races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
SOUTHERN BOULEVARD shaped better than the result suggests on debut before confirming that promise when third at the Curragh 26 days ago, and with further progress anticipated, she is taken to come out on top. Arrowstock sets the standard on the form of her fourth at Navan and rates the chief danger, while newcomer Eagle Eclipse is a half-brother to two sprint winners and should be sharp enough to make an impact if inheriting their early pace.

  1. SOUTHERN BOULEVARD (IRE)
  2. ARROWSTOCK (IRE)
  3. EAGLE ECLIPSE (IRE)

races.name: OCS Recruitment Handicap
races.verdict:
AMERILIS has been knocking on the door with a couple of runner-up efforts of late and is narrowly selected to go one better. Cashel Blue was just behind the selection last time and rates the chief danger, while Another Nice’day, who beat them both at Navan in July, is respected but must now confirm that form on worse terms.

  1. AMERILIS
  2. CASHEL BLUE (IRE)
  3. ANOTHER NICE'DAY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict:
ALWAYSANANGEL shaped with plenty of promise when third in a Group 2 at Newmarket last month, coming from a poor position and staying on strongly late. The step up to 7f should suit and she is fancied to land this Listed prize. Maire Rua looked above average when overcoming a poor draw to win on debut and rates the biggest threat given her huge potential, while the booking of Ryan Moore for Madam Secretary suggests she may still have more to offer.

  1. ALWAYSANANGEL (IRE)
  2. MAIRE RUA
  3. MADAM SECRETARY (IRE)

races.name: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
PRINCESS CHILD really found form at this time last year and might prove the answer to this listed race for Joseph O'Brien and Dylan Browne McMonagle. Carolina Jetstream will find this easier than the Group 1 Pretty Polly and is second choice ahead of Suzie Songs, a Group 3 winner last year who looked back on song when quickening well to beat Fort Vega in a Naas conditions event last time.

  1. PRINCESS CHILD (FR)
  2. CAROLINA JETSTREAM
  3. SUZIE SONGS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
BOSPHORUS ROSE has upped her game for new connections this season and had something in hand when winning a Roscommon listed race last time. She makes fair appeal. Nyra and Amelia Earhart are feared most.

  1. BOSPHORUS ROSE
  2. NYRA (GER)
  3. AMELIA EARHART (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
This is a slightly belated return to action for GARDEN PARTY but she showed more than enough last autumn to think a race like this is within her grasp. Dermot Weld's Zadawa has made a promising start to her career and is feared most unless the betting speaks in the favour of the selection's debuting stablemate Fairylike.

  1. GARDEN PARTY (IRE)
  2. ZADAWA (FR)
  3. FAIRYLIKE (USA)

races.name: Fitzgerald Construction Building 'A' Rated Homes Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Most of these are exposed which makes LEANNESPOUR all the more interesting on the back of her promising handicap debut fourth at Gowran 3 weeks ago. The return to 1m will suit recent Gowran third Dawn Flame who is second choice with Dylan Browne McMonagle taking the reins again. Mullacash Buzz and last week's Leopardstown scorer Launch Time also make the shortlist, whilst Reponse Finale would also be very interesting if lining up.

  1. LEANNESPOUR (IRE)
  2. DAWN FLAME
  3. MULLACASH BUZZ (IRE)

races.name: Chapel Down Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
WE RIDE AT DAWN has had the form of her Sandown success boosted and may be able to cope with a 5 lb rise. In-form older rivals Grey Fox and Raintown may chase her home in that order.

  1. WE RIDE AT DAWN
  2. GREY FOX (IRE)
  3. RAINTOWN (IRE)

races.name: TPT Fire Supports St Michaels Hospice EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Str)
races.verdict:
Newcomers QUICKEN AWAY and Sockdolager were both put in the Group 2 Royal Lodge at Newmarket earlier in the week, suggesting they are well regarded by leading stables. The former has an eyecatching pedigree and is preferred before any betting clues are known. Dontlookbackinanga made a promising start to his career at Sandown last month and may prove best of the remainder.

  1. QUICKEN AWAY (USA)
  2. SOCKDOLAGER (IRE)
  3. DONTLOOKBACKINANGA (IRE)

races.name: Highclere Horse Feeds EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Str)
races.verdict:
Group-entered SWEETWONDERFULYOU made a pleasing start to her career at Ascot and expected to build on that, she looks the answer. Art of Life went with plenty of zest when second here 3 weeks ago and is feared most.

  1. SWEETWONDERFULYOU (IRE)
  2. ART OF LIFE
  3. ISABELLA DE VEGA (IRE)

races.name: BetVictor Watch Weekend Winners EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting conditions race. EVENFALL has been put in multiple Group races since her Yarmouth debut defeat of a next-time-out scorer and gets a narrow vote ahead of Godolphin's Ascot winner Sorrengail, who also holds pattern entries.

  1. EVENFALL
  2. SORRENGAIL
  3. SPIRIT OF LYRA (IRE)

races.name: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict:
Speedy FAST TRACK has shown more than enough to suggest she can win at listed level and is narrowly preferred to Efsixteen, who could reap the rewards if the pace is overly strong. Fellow Group 1 entrant Acting Lady also needs considering, along with improving Acclamation Star.

  1. FAST TRACK (IRE)
  2. EFSIXTEEN
  3. ACTING LADY (IRE)

races.name: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
ZATSGOOD is taken to gain compensation for his near miss at Newcastle last time. Interesting stable and handicap debutant Scutari could be a serious danger, with Stratocracy appealing most of the remainder.

  1. ZATSGOOD
  2. SCUTARI
  3. STRATOCRACY (IRE)

races.name: UAE President Cup Series - Group 3 Pure Arabian Stakes
Betfred 'Nifty 50' Nursery
races.verdict:
WISE AND WONDERFUL shaped better than the result on nursery debut at Goodwood, keeping on when hampered in the closing stages, so she is taken to resume her progress in this lower grade. She can see off the challenge of Greek Symphony who continues to go the right way, while Minster Boy could fare better up in trip.

  1. WISE AND WONDERFUL
  2. GREEK SYMPHONY
  3. MINSTER BOY (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Bet Builder' EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TIORA TIME built on her debut effort when picking up well to score at Doncaster and, with further improvement to come, she can score again if taking up this engagement. Next best looks to be Tansy Lane, who also showed the benefit of her first run when not beaten far at Newmarket, ahead of Diplomata.

  1. TIORA TIME
  2. TANSY LANE
  3. DIPLOMATA

races.name: Betfred 'The Classic Bookmaker' Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful over C&D on his first outing in July, SIR GARFIELD fared second-best of those with a single figure stall at Goodwood last time, so he's well worth another chance back here. He gets the vote ahead of Modern Times, who arrives on the back of a winning stable debut, with Ruby's Profit one to note for her new yard.

  1. SIR GARFIELD (IRE)
  2. MODERN TIMES
  3. RUBY'S PROFIT (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Play Fred's 5 Million' Handicap
races.verdict:
TIME TO SPARKLE has taken well to this trip recently and has been knocking on the door in slightly better contests so she could be too good up against some older rivals for the first time. Offiah's Boy holds obvious claims under a penalty having scored comfortably at Lingfield and could be a big threat, while Haveagobeau is another that comes here in good form.

  1. TIME TO SPARKLE
  2. OFFIAH'S BOY
  3. HAVEAGOBEAU

races.name: Betfred 'Double Delight' Handicap
races.verdict:
CHANTELLE took a small step forward when second over C&D on her turf debut 15 days ago and given she should prove sharper for that return from 5 months off, is taken to reverse the form with Trio. Loblolly is back down in grade with first-time cheekpieces added so could also go well.

  1. CHANTELLE
  2. LOBLOLLY (IRE)
  3. TRIO

races.name: Betfred 'Follow Us On X' Handicap
races.verdict:
ICE CUBE confirmed recent promise when getting off the mark over C&D and a 3 lb rise is unlikely to prevent him following up against several much more exposed sorts. Indeed, the other pair of 3-y-os, Eyes Front and Spacewoman, could prove his biggest dangers.

  1. ICE CUBE (IRE)
  2. EYES FRONT (IRE)
  3. SPACEWOMAN

races.name: Download The QuinnBet App 'Confined' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Impossible to oppose MATINS in this match given he looked a useful prospect at the very least when scoring cosily on debut at Salisbury 3 weeks ago.

  1. MATINS
  2. EMPEROR AURELIUS (FR)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Those with experience appeal as longer-term projects so this could be prime for a newcomer. ROCK MONTREAL makes plenty of appeal on paper and holds Group race entries so could be the way to go. Fellow debutant Junior Again is another to monitor in the betting for a positive move, with On Target next best.

  1. ROCK MONTREAL (IRE)
  2. JUNIOR AGAIN (IRE)
  3. ON TARGET (FR)

races.name: Download The QuinnBet App Handicap
races.verdict:
Having finished placed on 3 of his 5 starts so far this season, ARCTURUS FLAME has joined a yard that excels with new recruits and, with his usual cheekpieces back on (also tongue tied) he could be the answer eased back down in class. Zachary Hickes is an interesting handicap debutant for the Roger Varian stable and commands respect, whilst Divot arrives in search of a quick-fire course hat-trick and can't be dismissed.

  1. ARCTURUS FLAME (IRE)
  2. ZACHARY HICKES
  3. DIVOT

races.name: QuinnBet Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
LETSBEATSEPSIS won a similar event at Windsor earlier this month and given he shouldn't be inconvenienced by the drop back in trip, is selected to follow up. Heer's Sadie and Nicely Curved should also go well.

  1. LETSBEATSEPSIS
  2. HEER'S SADIE
  3. NICELY CURVED (USA)

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
RUMBLE RUBY got back to winning ways at Beverley on Wednesday and can go well again under a penalty. Creative Queen ran a bit better fitted with cheekpieces at Ripon and is respected with the blinkers back on. Always Perfect is also in the mix.

  1. RUMBLE RUBY
  2. CREATIVE QUEEN (USA)
  3. ALWAYS PERFECT (IRE)

races.name: Danny Frost - Medlock Electrical Distributors Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
MAYFLOWER ROCK is still low mileage and left the impression a race of this nature is within her compass when a staying-on third at this course earlier this month. She gets the nod. Mister Sandman and Thursday's Lingfield winner My Mate Mackley are a couple of the other key players.

  1. MAYFLOWER ROCK
  2. MISTER SANDMAN
  3. MY MATE MACKLEY

races.name: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NECROMANCER can get off the mark from the improving Cool King at the second time of asking. Of the newcomers, Mount St and Sontsivka appeal as best of the rest.

  1. NECROMANCER
  2. COOL KING
  3. MOUNT ST (IRE)

races.name: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GLIDING THE LILY shaped with plenty of encouragement in making up considerable ground in the final 1f on her recent debut at Wolverhampton and is taken to open her account at the second time of asking with improvement on the cards. However, strong market support for well-bred newcomer Evening Call would put a slightly different slant on matters.

  1. GILDING THE LILY
  2. EVENING CALL
  3. DATE LINE

races.name: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
races.verdict:
THE SWEET ESCAPE is thriving at present and looks the one to be with having been denied only narrowly in his hat-trick bid in a competitive handicap at Galway just under a fortnight ago. Rising Force is an obvious threat having belatedly shown he's up to defying this sort of mark with a good second over C&D recenty. Sir Edward Lear is pick of the remainder.

  1. THE SWEET ESCAPE
  2. RISING FORCE (IRE)
  3. SIR EDWARD LEAR

races.name: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
races.verdict:
FIFTY NIFTY cashed in on a much-reduced mark on just third outing for current yard over C&D last week and remains very well treated on old form, so he's taken to make light of a 5 lb penalty. Ziggy's Condor ought to give another good account, while 3-y-o Molly Mac and Mumayaz are others to consider.

  1. FIFTY NIFTY (IRE)
  2. ZIGGY'S CONDOR (IRE)
  3. MOLLY MAC (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
HICKORY has a small rise for his Ascot success last time and just about makes most appeal in what is a competitive handicap. Storm Star has yet to win on turf but heads the list of dangers, from Principality and God Of War.

  1. HICKORY (IRE)
  2. STORM STAR
  3. PRINCIPALITY (IRE)

races.name: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
FREE WORLD finally put it all together to open his account from a falling mark last time and stands out here at the weights. An Bradan Feasa continues in good heart and should be thereabouts once more while The Craftymaster can't be dismissed from this mark on the pick of his efforts.

  1. FREE WORLD
  2. AN BRADAN FEASA (IRE)
  3. THE CRAFTYMASTER

races.name: Ray And Eileen McLean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a golden opportunity for FINAL OBJECTIVE to open his account. Karl Burke's Royal Strike may be the one to follow him home, with newcomers Knightbolt and Scenic Route worth noting for each-way support.

  1. FINAL OBJECTIVE (IRE)
  2. ROYAL STRIKE (IRE)
  3. KNIGHTBOLT (IRE)

races.name: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks an appealing match-up between VARZI and National Honour, with Karl Burke's juvenile narrowly preferred on the strength of his debut form.

  1. VARZI (IRE)
  2. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  3. WORK LIKE HELL

races.name: Heineken 0% Handicap
races.verdict:
A strongly-run race could tip this tricky sprint in favour of EMERALD HARMONY, who caught the eye with her move into contention at York last time. Accrual and Managing Director are both entitled to make bold bids, with Tuesday's Nottingham scorer Moulin Booj not taken lightly under a penalty.

  1. EMERALD HARMONY (IRE)
  2. ACCRUAL
  3. MANAGING DIRECTOR (IRE)

races.name: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for plenty and it could pay to give another chance to RETURN OF THE GODS, whose finishing effort didn't quite match the way he travelled into the contest at York last month but Ed Bethell's charge should find this easier. This switch to a handicap may well elicit further progress from Derrygarran Lad, so he heads up the dangers, with Indefensible and Enchant taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. RETURN OF THE GODS (IRE)
  2. DERRYGARRAN LAD (FR)
  3. INDEFENSIBLE (IRE)

races.name: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
races.verdict:
A host in with chances but the vote goes to MILITARY LEADER, who has upped his game significantly this season and Phillip Makin's 5-y-o arrives on the back of a career-best effort. Blinkers have had a positive effect on Mount King, so he could be the one to offer most resistance, with Travis and Donna Nook another couple worth considering, also.

  1. MILITARY LEADER
  2. MOUNT KING (IRE)
  3. TRAVIS

races.name: Birra Moretti Handicap
races.verdict:
HALIMEDE has looked a different proposition since tackling handicaps over trips more in line with her pedigree and this represents a golden opportunity for Sir Mark Prescott's filly to complete a hat-trick under a double penalty. Recobella can chase her home.

  1. HALIMEDE (IRE)
  2. RECOBELLA (FR)
  3. PRINCE ACHILLE

races.name: Seamus Byrne Electrical Chase
races.verdict:
MORE COKO (FR) ran his best race when second at Fairyhouse in January over 17f and he's in the right hands to make a winning reappearance assuming he gets home back up in trip. Rocky's Diamond has previous form to suggest he can prove a real threat but he was only workmanlike in victory over hurdles recently and faces some questions returning to chasing.

  1. MORE COKO (FR)
  2. ROCKY'S DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. THECOMPANYSERGEANT

races.name: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
Successful over C&D on her penultimate start, MENAS MIRACLE needs to shrug off a lesser effort at Wexford in June, yet her record at this venue is a particularly solid one and she's fancied to bounce back following a short break. My Cullen, Dunany Point, Thewaybackhome and Not So Serious head up an extensive list of credible dangers.

  1. MENAS MIRACLE (IRE)
  2. MY CULLEN (IRE)
  3. DUNANY POINT (IRE)

races.name: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SIMPLE THINGS may well find this a sharp enough test but she's the one to beat on these terms and shades preference over Willie Mullins' steadily improving World As One. Chasing Blues has also shown more than enough to play a significant role in proceedings.

  1. SIMPLE THINGS (IRE)
  2. WORLD AS ONE (GER)
  3. CHASING BLUES (IRE)

races.name: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TINGARRAN EXPRESS ran her best race since landing this event 12 months ago when second at Clonmel in June and, with her subsequent chase debut effort likely best overlooked, she rates a likely player to take the prize again. Del Boys Diva is thriving in handicaps and rates a big player in her hat-trick bid. Rare Times and Galileo Springs complete the dangers.

  1. TINGARRAN EXPRESS (IRE)
  2. DEL BOYS DIVA (IRE)
  3. RARE TIMES (IRE)

races.name: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Worth keeping an eye on the market for this very ordinary maiden. QUIET IN BRESIL and Hello Below set the standard, with Daniel King's mount just shading the vote. The respective runners of Willie Mullins and Gordon Elliott have to be considered, along with hurdling debutant Treacys Ella.

  1. QUIET IN BRESIL (FR)
  2. HELLO BELOW (IRE)
  3. ROOM FOR ONE MORE (IRE)

races.name: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MIGHTY BERKSHIRE has looked a different proposition the last twice, doing well to make up as much ground as he did when opening his account at Galway, and is taken to follow up with his yard in top form. Tolka Row is feared most on the back of his breakthrough success, with Diamond Secret also considered if taking up this engagement.

  1. MIGHTY BERKSHIRE (IRE)
  2. TOLKA ROW (IRE)
  3. DIAMOND SECRET (FR)

races.name: Clem Jacob Hire Flat Race
races.verdict:
Willie and Patrick Mullins have dominated this race in recent seasons, winning 6 of the previous 7 renewals, so their LONG'WAY gets the vote to enhance that record further. Mountain Sky heads up the dangers having found just one too strong on both starts since his debut, with newcomer Call My Name rounding off the shortlist.

  1. LONG'WAY (FR)
  2. MOUNTAIN SKY
  3. CALL MY NAME (IRE)

Prix Du Motel Ascot A Cagnes-sur-mer Stakes
Prix C'est Vendredi, J'ecoute Radio Balances Stakes
Prix Du Cardinal, Porte De Saint-cloud Maiden Stakes
